// helper to expand to 25 items per category by repeating if necessary
const fillTo25 = (arr) => {
  const res = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 25; i++) {
    res.push(arr[i % arr.length]);
  }
  return res;
};

const categoriesOrder = [
  'World',
  'Tech',
  'Sports',
  'Health',
  'Science',
  'Business',
  'Entertainment',
  'Travel'
];

// flatten urls in same order used for category array
const urls = categoriesOrder.flatMap((cat) => fillTo25(categoryUrlMap[cat] || []));

const categories = categoriesOrder.flatMap((cat) => Array(25).fill(cat));

const articles = urls.map((url, idx) => ({
  id: idx + 1,
  category: categories[idx],
  title: `${categories[idx]} Article ${idx + 1}`,
  description: `This is a summary for ${categories[idx]} article ${idx + 1}.`,
  content: `Full content for ${categories[idx]} article ${idx + 1}.`,
  imageUrl: url,
  author: 'Reporter',
  date: '2025-01-01'
}));

export default articles;
